purpose: Teach: テナント/争議/励まさ/数回/封じ/裏付ける/先代/小論文

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 駅前ビルの、本気で、絶対、テナント、絶対、空き状況、絶対、確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's make absolutely sure we check the tenant vacancy status in the station-front building.
lines.style: Businesslike and direct. Crisp opening on the task. Steady pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone setting an agenda with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働、本気で、絶対、争議、絶対、対応、絶対、人事と、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling the labor dispute response with HR right now, and I'm grateful for your support.
lines.style: Earnest and measured. Slight weight on the update itself—this matters. Even pace, calm delivery. The reassurance of someone reporting progress without drama.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員が、本気で、絶対、励まされ、絶対、る、絶対、社風、絶対、大切にしましょう
lines.en: It's important that our staff feel encouraged and supported. Let's keep cherishing that culture.
lines.style: Warm but thoughtful. Pause before the main clause—she's choosing her words carefully. Slower pace. The sincerity of someone who means what she's saying about values.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議を、本気で、絶対、数回、絶対、重ねて、絶対、方針、絶対、まとめました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've held several meetings to finalize our approach, and I appreciate your collaboration.
lines.style: Calm, straightforward report. Steady rhythm through the details. No rush. The tone of someone confirming what's been accomplished without overselling it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合の動きを、本気for、絶対、封じる、絶対、戦略、絶対、検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's also think through a strategy to counter what our competitors are doing.
lines.style: Decisive and forward-looking. Quick pickup on the new point. Brisk but not rushed. The clarity of someone pivoting to the next priority without losing the team.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の効果、本気で、絶対、お客様の声で、絶対、裏付ける、絶対、データ、絶対、集めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're gathering customer feedback and data to back up the effectiveness of our new product.
lines.style: Engaged and methodical. Slight emphasis on the customer voice as the foundation. Even pace through the process. The voice of someone building a case carefully.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、先代、絶対、の精神、絶対、社員に、絶対、伝えていきましょう
lines.en: We should pass on the spirit of our company's predecessors to all our staff going forward.
lines.style: Gentle and reflective. Softer opening on the principle itself. Slower pace, more breathing room between thoughts. The reverence of someone honoring tradition while looking ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報誌の、本気で、絶対、小論文、絶対、コンクール、絶対、開催しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently running an essay contest in our company newsletter to encourage that spirit.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Lighter tone—there's accomplishment here. Steady pace with a subtle lift at the end. The voice of someone finishing strong and showing genuine care.
